source: ISO 4762 / DIN 912 M5 socket-head cap screw: head dk 8.5 mm, k 5.0 mm, hex key s 4.0 mm (the 4 mm key Shimano specifies for SPD cleat bolts); clearance hole 5.5 mm per ISO 273 medium; tap drill 4.2 mm per ISO 261.
frame: fastener: axis along Z, origin on the head bearing face, shank toward -Z, head toward +Z

counterbore_diameter.source: ASSUMPTION: head diameter + 0.4 mm FDM print slack (uncertainty +/-0.2 mm); convention, not a standard

counterbore_depth.source: ASSUMPTION: head height + 0.2 mm so the head sits flush or below the surface (uncertainty +/-0.2 mm)

tap_diameter.source: ISO 261 / DIN 336 tap drill for M5 coarse thread (6H), used as the pilot for a threaded or heat-set hole

tool_access_height.source: ASSUMPTION: straight clearance above the head for a hex key or bit and driver (about 25 mm; uncertainty +/-10 mm; owner may override)

length.source: request text (nominal screw length l under the head; stock lengths are standard, so it is chosen per design)

gate_params.source: sample length used only by the load-time validation gate; never a design value

import_gate_notes: R1: bounding box = head_diameter x head_diameter x (length + head_height), tolerance 0.2 mm; the head is modelled as a plain cylinder (cylinder head with hex socket drive socket and rounding omitted: envelope only). Datum directions are unit vectors. Designed contact (head on its bearing face, thread in its tapped or heat-set hole) is not interference. The tool_access keepout is a reserved volume above the head, not a solid.

self_checks.name: head larger than the clearance hole
counterbore deep enough for the head
hex key fits inside the head
